learning_outcomes.text: Has knowledge of intellectual and industrial property protection. Has knowledge of the principles of patent preparation.
Knows the possibilities that patents offer as sources of information.
Knows the mechanisms governing the patenting of modern inventions and understands the essence of their application.
Can critically evaluate the approach of global companies to the creation and commercialization of products, including intellectual property protection.

Can discuss the features of a patent application based on the practical method of "patent feature analysis", which relies on searches in the European Patent Office database, considering the characteristic features of a given application.
Understands the need for continuous education and improvement of competences in the field of intellectual and industrial property protection.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to intellectual property protection in light of European and American patent law
Industrial property as a type of exclusive rights
Protection of an invention based on claims
Patentability of algorithms and computer programs in Europe and the USA
Other forms of intellectual property protection
Patent as a source of market information
assessment_rules: Lectures are verified by a test. Students participate in classes, learning subsequent teaching content according to the course syllabus. Students should ask questions and clarify doubts on an ongoing basis.
